experiments.scope: Tests H1, H1-P1, H5' and the P1 sum-claw / A.31 folded post-filter chain (proof.md Sections 2-5, A.31). Trials 0..7: a first block drawn from SHAKE-256 of the seed, its real 38-step chaining value, and the counted P1 claw procedure at a reduced table of 2^16 slots loaded with 2^17 candidates (two per slot, one side bit per slot) with 2^12 distinct scan words u0 + n: table build, scan, A.31 folded post-filters C1, C2, G, F7 (segments 6, 22, 29, 31), and step 3b on every good pair. Every claw is verified three ways: against an independent sorted-array search over the same table and words (claws_equal_ref), by rebuilding the real E16 of member x (claw_e16_in_S160), and by evaluating the post-filters on the real words of both members (postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, confirming the A.31 constant folds K2E5 and cW8 are bit-exact on every claw). A pair is returned only if step 3b accepts it (rows 16..21 pass and A34..A37, E34..E37 are equal); none is expected at this reduced size. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair itself (accepts, 3,014 operations). Trials 9..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 (none expected at the reduced size; any returned pair is a full collision). On every working trial: claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Reproducible observations: occ_frac (about 0.865 at two candidates per slot), claws against expected_claws, the stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, good_pairs (each runs step 3b), step3b_collisions and counted_ops.

experiments.scope: Tests the two-window (W9/W11) row-16..21 and post-filter transfer laws behind H1-P1, H2-P1, H3-P1 and H10-P1-W11-deep-transfer (proof.md Sections 7-9, A.26, A.27, A.31). Trials 0..7: on a seed-drawn chaining value, builds the claw table from the binding two-window candidate family W9 = [9 x 2^26, 10 x 2^26) and W11 = [11 x 2^26, 12 x 2^26) (2^17 two-window candidates across 2^16 slots with side-bit window recovery) and scans 2^13 distinct words u0 + n; for every claw (reporting w9_claws, w11_claws and side_bad = 0) both members are rebuilt and the tests of rows 16..21 of step 3b are applied in order, reporting cumulative row passes rows_le16..rows_le21, post-filter stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, and distinct_pairs. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair (accepts, 3,014 ops). Trial 9 executes a paired W9-vs-W11 transfer probe across four seed-drawn chaining values (2,048 paired C1-conditioned (off, a1) draws evaluated at both a0 in W9 and a0 in W11): it compares W9 vs W11 across the A.31 post-filter chain (w9_c1, w11_c1, w9_c1c2, w11_c1c2, w9_c1c2g, w11_c1c2g, w9_all4, w11_all4), verifies bit-exactness against pf_ref (pf_mismatch = 0), and counts the forced value-bit events B_t = ((E_t^x & m_t) == v_t) of rows 17..21 on both windows (w9_e17_21_bits, w11_e17_21_bits). No pair is returned by design (good-pair step-3b acceptance is ~2^-71).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. On Trials 0..7: distinct_pairs = claws, rows_le16 = row16_passes = claws, side_bad = 0, and w9_claws + w11_claws = claws with balanced W9/W11 claw counts on every working trial. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Trial 9: pf_mismatch = 0, w9_c1 = w11_c1 = 2048, and W9 vs W11 stage counts (w9_c1c2 vs w11_c1c2, w9_c1c2g vs w11_c1c2g) and row 17..21 forced-bit counts (w9_e17_21_bits vs w11_e17_21_bits) agree within binomial sampling variation.

experiments.scope: Tests the binding two-window (W9/W11) seven-lane bucket table, 1-bit-per-lane side array, displacement head probe_lean (14 ops/head), conditional second-window read, A.31 folded post-filters (6, 22, 29, 31) and conditional empty-lane chain law of proof.md A.15, A.18, A.19, A.22, A.23, A.25, A.27, A.30 and A.31 (H1, H5', H7, H8, H9, H10). Trials 0..3 draw a first block from SHAKE-256 of the seed, take its real 38-step chaining value, build the seven-lane bucket table over the two-window (W9/W11) candidate set with its 1-bit-per-lane side array (2^16 two-window candidates across 2^23 buckets of seven 36-bit lanes, +6 side-store ops/candidate and +4 per retained lane; full scale 2^27 candidates across 2^23 buckets), scan 2^13 distinct words u0 + n using A.19's displacement head (14 ops/head) and +4 side-read ops/match, and verify every claw against an independent sorted-array search (claws_equal_ref), real E16 in S160 (row16_bad = 0), window recovery in W9 union W11 (side_bad = 0, w9_claws, w11_claws), and A.31 post-filter exactness against pf_ref (postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0). Trial 4 executes the CONDITIONAL empty-lane chain law of A.15.10 under A.31's folded segments (6, 22, 29, 31) over 32,768 conditional fires. Trial 5 executes A.15.7's union mask and conditional second read over 40,000 random seven-lane words. Trial 6 executes the binding two-window (W9/W11) packed 256-bit seven-lane bucket table + 1-bit-per-lane side array + probe_lean (14 ops/head) + conditional second read + A.31 post-filters at the exact full-scale load factor 16 = 2^4 candidates per bucket (2^15 two-window candidates across 2^11 seven-lane buckets, E[filled] = 6.9941 of 7, scanning 2^8 words).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. On Trials 0..3: claws_equal_ref = 1, row16_bad = 0, side_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, w9_claws + w11_claws = claws, and claws is consistent with 40 x occupied_lanes/7 x 2^13 x 4/2^9. Trial 4: empty_draws near 4,187,704, empty_n = 32,768, empty_ops_milli near 9,150 (A.31 folded conditional mean; ledger conservatively charges 10,350), empty_all4 = 0, empty_ub_e7 near 1,651 (H8). Trial 5: fused_fires + fused_coincidences = fused_passes with fused_mismatches = 0. Trial 6 (full-scale load 16 = 2^4 two-window table): load16_filled_milli near 6,994 (theoretical 6,994.1), load16_emitted + load16_coincidences = load16_passes, load16_w9_emitted + load16_w11_emitted = load16_emitted, and load16_mask_bad = load16_lean_bad = load16_side_bad = load16_row16_bad = load16_pf_bad = 0.
